title: Admit PR evidence reviewed on an identical tree
body:
Two operator D10 exceptions on 2026-10-29 (#135 message-only rewrite, #474 merge of an identical-tree base) re-ran full panels on trees that already had a PASS record (00fcafd^{tree}=0b2c2d1^{tree}, 9cade94e^{tree}=4073c909^{tree}). Independent review and process judges ranked binding acceptance to the commit SHA instead of the tree as a top cost driver. ADR 0014 D22 keeps the exact-head record, so this needs an operator decision before any implementation.
Acceptance: first, the operator decides whether to amend D22 so that a complete PASS (or recorded override) record may carry over to a head with exactly the same tree and the same series; the decision is recorded in ADR 0014. Only if accepted: PR admission links the new head to the reviewed record by tree identity, still verifies trailers, base ancestry and CI on the exact head, and a frozen observer fails on the base by assertion and passes on the head. If rejected, close this task as dropped with the decision reference.
